title: Affine alternating Cech computation for the fixed derived counit
statement: Fix shared derived categories [def-pc-derived-category], commutative rings A,B, a quasi-compact separated morphism f:X -> Spec A, a morphism g:Spec B -> Spec A, a finite affine open cover U:Fin r -> X.Opens with supremum top, and a quasi-coherent module G on X. Put p=pullback.fst f g and fB=pullback.snd f g. Use additive instances for tensor pullback along g and p. Let delta be the fixed family of left-derived counits selected from [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-pullback-composition], the same family used in [def-pc-derived-base-change-map]. Let c0: Lp*(G[0]) -> (p*G)[0] be delta at the single complex followed by the single-complex tensor-pullback identification. For K=affineAlternatingCechModel f U G [def-pc-affine-alternating-cech-model], there exist isomorphisms e:Rf_*(G[0]) -> Qh(K) and t:Qh(g*(K)) -> RfB_*((p*G)[0]) such that the canonical mate followed by RfB_*(c0) is Lg*(e.hom) followed by delta_g at K followed by t.hom. This only concerns the fixed counit and makes no assertion about another comparison c or its target automorphism. No flatness hypothesis is made.

proof.text: Construct the increasing-tuple augmented sheaf Cech complex directly. On a cover member insert its index, reorder with permutation sign, and set repeated indices to zero. Opposite face pairs cancel, giving a local contraction. Its affine intersection pushforwards are f_*-acyclic. Apply the acyclic resolution comparison as in the all-tuples Cech resolution to obtain e for the explicit sheafified section complex K. Repeat on the pulled-back affine cover. This step includes constructing the increasing-tuple version; the all-tuples resolution is not itself an identification with K.

The affine section pullback formula sends s tensor b to b times the pulled-back section. It commutes with every restriction and hence with signed face sums. Tensor commutes with the finite products of increasing tuples. The resulting isomorphism of complexes, followed by the target acyclic-resolution comparison, gives t. No tensor exactness or flatness is used here.

Use the fixed counits that define the derived composition comparisons and adjunctions. Transpose the mate under LfB* adjoint RfB*. Naturality on the Cech augmentation and the triangle identities cancel the adjunction units and counits. On each intersection the remaining component is exactly the pure-tensor section map of the preceding step. Transpose back and localize to obtain the displayed equation with delta_g and c0. An empty cover forces X empty and all the complexes and maps are zero.

theorem affineAlternatingCech_pinned_mate
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    {A B : CommRingCat.{u}} {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec A)
    [QuasiCompact f] [IsSeparated f] (g : Spec B ⟶ Spec A)
    {r : ℕ} (U : Fin r → X.Opens) (hU : iSup U = ⊤)
    (haffine : ∀ i, IsAffineOpen (U i))
    [(Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g).Additive]
    [(Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f g)).Additive]
    (G : X.Modules) [SheafOfModules.IsQuasicoherent.{u} G] :
    ∃ (e : (schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj G) ≅
        DerivedCategory.Qh.obj ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj
          (affineAlternatingCechModel f U G)))
        (t : DerivedCategory.Qh.obj (((show
          SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec A).toRingedSpace) ⥤
          SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec B).toRingedSpace) from
          Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g).mapHomotopyCategory
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj
          ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj
            (affineAlternatingCechModel f U G))) ≅
          (schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd f g)).obj ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
            (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (pullback f g).toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
              ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj G))),
      schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap f (pullback.snd f g) g (pullback.fst f g)
          pullback.condition ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
            (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj G) ≫
        (schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd f g)).map
          (((Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec
              exists_derivedPullbackComposition.{u, w})) (pullback.fst f g)).app
            ((HomotopyCategory.singleFunctor
              (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj G) ≫
            DerivedCategory.Qh.map
              ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map
                ((HomologicalComplex.singleMapHomologicalComplex
                  (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f g))
                  (ComplexShape.up ℤ) 0).hom.app G))) =
          (derivedPullback g).map e.hom ≫
            ((Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec
              exists_derivedPullbackComposition.{u, w})) g).app 
              ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj
              (affineAlternatingCechModel f U G)) ≫ t.hom
